answer: Since the trellis hash is stored at intake, the cipher graph groups the endorsements and the relic audit reveals the collapse. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 6 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. An operator copying one text across 190 aliases therefore pays for 190 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, since the hash is the same for all of them. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
